_doc: What interrupts the player (hud.gd). Achievements (the tribe's firsts) of the kinds in feat_dialog open a dialog (a new era and a first contact already open their dilemma, so they are notices) (paused, with a picture); all others show as a banner notice that can be clicked to look there. contract_done: "notice" (a banner) or "dialog" when a Task Contract finishes. trader: "notice" shows a trader's arrival as a banner (click it to open the market; after trader_wait game seconds the trader goes home) or "dialog". gap: real seconds after a dialog closes before a waiting achievement dialog opens. Dilemmas and emergencies always ask; routine dilemmas ("routine" in dilemmas.json) are the Steward's to decide when the player lets them.
